sermon.title: The Second Greatest Sin of All — October 17, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor Kincer teaches that the second greatest sin is breaking the second greatest law: love your neighbor. The temple patterns were shadows pointing to Christ; God rejects empty ritual and calls His people to do good, seek justice for the innocent, and praise with one sound.

faqs.question: Where should we get our definitions?
faqs.answer: From the Bible, not Webster’s dictionary.

faqs.question: Why does God allow evil?
faqs.answer: He says God gave you the responsibility to correct it.

faqs.question: What does he call David’s murder of Uriah?
faqs.answer: The unpardonable sin, yet forgiven when David repented.

faqs.question: Was David divorced?
faqs.answer: He says his first wife left him.

faqs.question: Does God hate?
faqs.answer: He points to “my soul hates” in Isaiah 1.

What is the American church doing?
